noLanguage.title: Open a design language first
noLanguage.body: The builder works inside a design language.

start.title: Build your design language with AI
start.lead: It asks a few questions, looks at your finished labels, builds the language and shows it on sample labels. Write what you don't like and the language is updated. Nothing changes in production until you publish.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: It asks which labels you make and how you usually set them.

samples.title: Samples
samples.body: Upload finished labels; measurements are taken from the images. No samples? It is built from your answers.

review.title: Preview and corrections
review.body: The language is shown on sample labels; write things like "make the date smaller" and a new version follows.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Publish when you like it; the previous version stays in the history.

claudeCode.title: Creating with Claude Code
claudeCode.lead: Instead of writing your design language rule by rule from scratch, Claude Code looks at your finished labels, asks you questions and writes the draft for you. You only answer, try it and publish.
claudeCode.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it by hand.

step1.title: Upload your finished labels
step1.body: Finished labels you imported earlier can be loaded while Claude Code builds the design language. The more numerous and varied the examples, the more accurate the draft.
step1.none: No examples have been loaded yet.

step2.title: Run the command in Claude Code
step2.body: Open a terminal in the TagPress project folder, type claude to start Claude Code, then type this command:
step2.note: The TagPress app must be open and running; Claude Code reaches the examples and the draft through it.

step3.title: Answer the questions, follow the draft
step3.body: Claude Code looks at your examples and asks about the rules group by group (fonts, sizes, line breaking…). The draft is written as you answer; you see it live in the Rules section.
step3.hasDraft: There is a draft right now.

step4.title: Try and publish
step4.body: Try the draft with sample orders and compare it with the published version. If you are happy, press “Publish” at the top of the page. If not, you can discard the draft; nothing is published without your knowledge.

session.title: Session status
session.empty: No session yet. It shows up here once you run the command from step 2 in Claude Code.
session.notConnected: The server has no session endpoint; Claude Code's questions and draft edits will show up here once it does.
